sources.snippet: RDT-1B is a 1B -parameter (largest to date) imitation learning Diffusion Transformer pre-trained on 1M+ (largest to date) multi-robot episodes. Given language instruction and RGB images of up to three views, RDT can predict the next 64 $64$ robot actions. sources.title: Demo Src Three Piece Assembly Task D1 Robot UR5e - claru.ai
sources.snippet: A cross-embodiment robotics dataset containing 500 episodes of a three-piece assembly task performed by a UR5e robot with Robotiq85 gripper. The dataset includes RGB observations from agent and wrist cameras, proprioceptive state information, and end-effector poses.
